title: Scope the rich-text cell panel wording to the select-first grid in READMEs and docs
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oY5WCqqqBMtn9qt7m

## What is wrong

PR #36278 (card #36023) lets a list cell edit a rich-text field (`markdown`, `html`, `richtext`). On a select-first grid (`cellSelection`, which the list view and the related tab use) the text box opens in a panel under the cell; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves and a click outside saves. On an `ObjectGrid` mounted without `cellSelection`, one click opens the text box over the cell, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter does nothing, Esc discards, and a click outside keeps the text as a pending change for the grid's save buttons. The changeset now says both (contract record 7075978816 S1, closed in 7076344850). These texts still describe only the select-first behaviour, without saying so:

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` (ships in the npm tarball): "opens the record form's text box in a panel under the cell (Enter is a new line, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves, Escape discards, a click outside saves)".
- `ui/packages/fields/README.md`: "The list grid opens it in a panel under the cell".
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`: the panel sentence (its keys sentence is already scoped).
- `.changeset/36023-rich-text-cell-panel.md` "Before, these cells opened no editor and said 'This field can't be edited in a list'": true only for select-first (no `describeCell`, so no notice, without `cellSelection`). If the changeset has already been consumed by a release, skip this line.
- The jsdoc on `IN_CELL_PANEL_EDIT_WIDGETS` in `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx` ("the grid saves on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter or a click outside").

Source of truth for the two hosts: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (`editsBelow = isEditing && selectFirst && editorBelow`; the injected-editor wrapper commits a TEXTAREA only under `selectFirst && (ctrlKey || metaKey)`; `autosaves = selectFirst && ...`).

Origin: seat 7's contract delta record 7076344850 on PR #36278, S2 (should-fix, non-blocking) and N1 (nit). Carried here by the maintainer's direction to put later small changes on their own card (2026-11-22T07:49Z).

## Done when

- Each text above names the select-first grid for the panel and its keys, and says in one sentence what a grid without `cellSelection` does.
- Text only: no code or behaviour change, no changeset needed beyond a patch note if a published README moves.
